caption: The drawing features a rectangular, wooden-framed plot on a sandy or earthy ground with tufts of green grass growing around its edges. Inside the framed plot, there is a box or carton labeled "Kellogg's WAFFLE MAC," partially covered or surrounded by green, drooping leaves or plants. On the right side of the frame, a simple wooden cross made of two uneven sticks is placed upright, decorated with a wreath or garland of bright pink flowers. The colors in the drawing are primarily earthy browns for the wood and ground, greens for the grass and foliage, pink for the flowers, and a mix of white, red, and black on the carton. The artist's name, "MAJEL G. CLAFLIN, TAOS. N.M.," is written in green in the bottom right corner.
title: Child's Grave with Hand Made Cross of Wood
